keys: # 第 6 周（文案 09_第6周.md），含分线点。编号 -9x 是选项文字。

zh: 修好通往温室区的断桥
en: Repair the broken bridge to the greenhouse district

zh: 早！今天去修桥，隐藏任务就在对面！
en: Morning! We're fixing the bridge today. The hidden quest is right on the other side!

zh: 苗又黄了……净水站也得抓紧。
en: The seedlings are yellowing again… We need to hurry with the water purifier too.

zh: 桥墩还是好的，只是中间断了。
en: The piers are still fine. It's just broken in the middle.

zh: 两个办法：我去现场把断掉的那段接起来，或者让机器人搭一座临时的便桥。
en: Two options: I go on site and reconnect the broken section, or the robots put up a temporary bridge.

zh: 断桥尚未修复，本周无法进入温室区。
en: The bridge has not been repaired. The greenhouse district cannot be reached this week.

zh: 新区域：C 温室与旧居民区
en: New area: C Greenhouse & Old Residential District

zh: 这就是温室……比工业区还安静。
en: So this is the greenhouse… It's even quieter than the industrial zone.

zh: 通信信号：不稳定（比之前更差）
en: Signal: Unstable (worse than before)

zh: 信号越来越差了……终点一定就在里面。
en: The signal's getting worse… Whatever's at the end must be in there.
Let's go in!

zh: 里面好暗……信号也快没了。我们……要进去吗？
en: It's really dark in there… and the signal's almost gone. Should we… go in?
Then… let's come back another time.
Connection lost
Huh? {ark}? It won't move!
Reconnecting…
Connection restored (weak signal)
…Who is that?

zh: 游戏里……有人？我玩了这么多年，一次都没见过。
en: There's… a person in the game? I've played this for years and never seen one.
{girl} is controlling ARK-01
What should I do…
He… put the part back.
It's like… he's scared of {ark}.

zh: ARK-01 自检：胸口盖板被打开。发现模块：音频收发器（旧型号，出厂后从未启用，已损坏）
en: ARK-01 self-diagnostic: Chest panel opened. Module found: Audio transceiver (legacy model, never activated since manufacture, damaged)
So {ark} had this inside all along.

zh: 要是能修好，是不是就能跟他说话了？
en: If we fix it, maybe we could talk to him?

zh: 新目标（第 7 周）：修复 ARK-01 的音频收发器（需要 通信 55）
en: New goal (Week 7): Repair ARK-01's audio transceiver (requires Comms 55)

zh: 我下周多上几节通信课吧。
en: I'll take more Comms classes next week.
Week 6 Summary
{player}, you saw it today too, didn't you.

zh: 我在小镇里待了七年，修了那么多东西，从来没见过别人。
en: I've spent seven years in that town, fixed so many things, and I've never seen anyone else.
…Why would there be a person in a game?
Never mind. I'll ask him myself next week.

zh: 隐藏任务的终点，到底在哪儿呢……
en: Where does the hidden quest actually end…

zh: {player}，你说，做这个游戏的人，为什么要做得这么大？
en: {player}, why do you think whoever made this game made it so big?
Good night.
Week 7
Okay…
Go in. I'm right here with you.
It's up to you. Go in if you want to.
Don't go in yet. It's too dangerous.

zh: 先别动，看看他要做什么。
en: Don't move yet. Let's see what he does.
Maybe say hi to him?
Be careful.
